summary: Design JSON spec for the 'live a little' daily-dare + storybook app. One file per page; shared values live in the tokens file and are referenced as 'token.*' / 'type.*' throughout.

howToRead.token.*: look up the literal value in 00-design-tokens.json (e.g. token.accent, token.line, token.radii.card).
howToRead.category.*: per-challenge values (color, tint, label, verb, icon) from 00-design-tokens.json > categories.
howToRead.ref: points to a component already fully described in another file (avoids duplication).
howToRead.variants: alternate renderings toggled by the user via the Tweaks panel.

files.describes: Global tokens: palettes, categories, typography scale, radii, shadows, spacing, motion, icon set, tweak variants.
Swipe deck home: header, draggable DareCard (bold/paper/duotone), swipe stamps, action bar.
Bottom sheet of accepted, in-progress dares.
Single dare view with encouragement note and give-back / done actions.
Photo + handwritten note capture; celebration on save.
Memory keepsake in three layouts: scrapbook (default), timeline, calendar.
Streak hero, stat tiles, category breakdown bars.
Bottom nav + Android device frame shared across tabs.

overlays.capture: from DareDetail 'Done' OR History/Storybook tap (edit mode)

navigationMap.primaryLoop: Discover swipe right -> ActiveSheet -> DareDetail -> CaptureMoment -> Celebration -> Storybook
